data.completion_memo: Audited every production Rust child-process launch. Confirmed MCP Tokio STDIO omitted Windows CREATE_NO_WINDOW; plugin, Codex probe, worker supervisor, native registry and detached helper used command-group defaults that also allocate consoles and overwrite underlying Command flags. Added shared safe aworkit-process::command helpers: direct command suppression and group-builder suppression. Routed all affected launches through them; existing managed Shell/Python ProcessTree already suppresses consoles. STDIO, environment, ownership, cancellation and authority semantics remain unchanged; intentional GUI windows remain possible. Verification: 23 integration checks passed across real Windows root/ordinary-child console handle probes, executable and .cmd MCP discovery/call/reconnect, MCP HTTP, plugins, process sessions and Codex probe protocols. Corrected Windows Python discovery in Codex tests so they execute instead of silently skipping. Native WebView fixture passed real MCP/.cmd, Shell and Python calls, with four server starts and all root/child console handles zero. Evidence: desktop/src-tauri/target/native-console-1789805855987/proof.json and startup.jsonl. Source audit: no production group_spawn bypasses. Release compilation/linking succeeded, but Cargo could not replace the running app's locked executable. Copied the newly linked release and verified SHA256 identity at desktop/src-tauri/target/release/aworkit-desktop-no-console.exe; live app untouched. Build also includes prior cache-prefix fix. Specification: docs/background-process-windows.md.
data.description: Audit all production child-process launch paths. Fix MCP STDIO plus plugin/external-agent/worker/helper command-group paths, retaining managed Shell/Python suppression. Verify actual Windows console handles and native MCP/tool execution with isolated fixtures. Build without interrupting the active app. Specification: docs/background-process-windows.md.
data.title: Suppress Windows console windows for all background tool and MCP launches
